project_type: Go compiler targeting minivm bytecode (Python 3.13 subset)
test_framework: Go testing with github.com/stretchr/testify/require, tests in *_test.go beside production code
verification_instructions: 1. go vet ./... 2. go test ./... 3. Run specific integration tests: go test -run TestCompile ./compiler
setup_instructions: Already set up: go 1.26.2 installed, dependencies downloaded. Just run go test ./...
environment_constraints: No Docker. No network restrictions observed (go mod download works). Pre-installed go 1.26.2.
contribution_requirements: docs/coding-patterns.md is normative. Violations are blocking defects. Key rules: one abstraction level per function, callers before callees, checker/lowerer synchronized, tests use public behavior only, helpers need 2+ callers, no private-state backdoors in tests. AGENTS.md completion gate must pass.
key_patterns: Checker in compiler/check*.go resolves types/names/narrowing. Lowerer in compiler/lower*.go emits minivm bytecode. Host functions in compiler/runtime.go bridge complex ops. Builtins in builtins/ own checker rules + emitter callbacks. Operator in operator/ owns all binary/unary/compare typing and lowering. Types in types/ define source type lattice + VM() mapping. Dynamic ref values use REF_TEST/REF_CAST for isinstance, REF_NULL/REF_IS_NULL for None checks, REF_EQ/REF_NE for identity.
directory_structure: token/ (token kinds, positions, diagnostics) | lexer/ (scanning) | ast/ (data-only syntax nodes) | parser/ (grammar, AST construction) | types/ (source type lattice, VM mapping) | module/ (native/source module registry) | builtins/ (builtin symbols, exception hierarchy) | operator/ (operator typing + lowering) | hostabi/ (host/minivm value bridge) | compiler/ (module graph, checker, specialization, lowerer, passes) | typing/ (annotation-only native module) | cmd/minipy/ (CLI/REPL)
